title: An issue was discovered in Kibana where a user with the Synthetics All privilege in one space can access Fleet agent…
description: A vulnerability in Kibana allows a user with the Synthetics All privilege in one space to access Fleet agent policy metadata from other spaces via a product API endpoint. This leads to unauthorized disclosure of operational metadata across spaces that the user should not have access to. The issue is classified as CWE-862 (Missing Authorization).
